discovery.prompt_guidance: Prefer specific source-stated technical predicates, defects, interface constraints and useful negative findings over task headers; preserve each source's reported-versus-verified status.

utility.prompt_guidance: Optimize useful development-knowledge recall. Accept a cited, source-supported technical constraint or reported defect even when it is not yet fixed. Do not classify the whole cluster as transient. Do not treat possible semantic duplication as a reason to reject an independently useful fact.
